analysis: A1 part 1 (census suite-size curve) on corrected census scores (census_rescore.jsonl)

meta.sampling: for each k = 3..15: all C(15,k) subsets if C(15,k) <= 3003 (k = 3,4,5,10..15), otherwise 2000 distinct subsets drawn uniformly without replacement (k = 6..9); one random.Random(20261021) instance consumed in order of k
meta.rules: a1_analysis.stage_one_flag / stage_two (scaled: flag s < 0.6k; suspect 15s <= 2k and 15b >= 8k; healthy s/b >= 0.6), analyze.py grouping and HIGH baseline siblings
meta.per_task_source: census_rescore.jsonl per_task for the 15 suite tasks, 305 ollama-official tags; all other row fields from results/audit_scored.jsonl
meta.reference: full 15-task suite on corrected scores: 43 flags, 7 suspects

validation_reproduces_released_a1.settings: original audit_scored.jsonl per_task, enumerate if C(15,k) <= 1000 else 1000 draws, seed 20261021

per_k.stage_one_rule: flag iff s < 1.8; unflagged needs s >= 2 (66.7% of k)
flag iff s < 2.4; unflagged needs s >= 3 (75.0% of k)
flag iff s < 3; unflagged needs s >= 3 (60.0% of k)
flag iff s < 3.6; unflagged needs s >= 4 (66.7% of k)
flag iff s < 4.2; unflagged needs s >= 5 (71.4% of k)
flag iff s < 4.8; unflagged needs s >= 5 (62.5% of k)
flag iff s < 5.4; unflagged needs s >= 6 (66.7% of k)
flag iff s < 6; unflagged needs s >= 6 (60.0% of k)
flag iff s < 6.6; unflagged needs s >= 7 (63.6% of k)
flag iff s < 7.2; unflagged needs s >= 8 (66.7% of k)
flag iff s < 7.8; unflagged needs s >= 8 (61.5% of k)
flag iff s < 8.4; unflagged needs s >= 9 (64.3% of k)
flag iff s < 9; unflagged needs s >= 9 (60.0% of k)

phi35_q2K_dropouts.note: phi3.5 q2_K scores 0; it leaves the suspect class only when the median of its q6_K/q8_0/fp16 siblings on the subset falls below 8k/15

stability_thresholds.note: smallest k such that the criterion holds at that k and every larger k

calibration_94pct_check.figure: share of 1000 random 15-of-164 HumanEval+ suites in which the 60% bar flags >= 1 healthy calibration config (P1 data, 23 healthy Qwen2.5-Coder configs)
calibration_94pct_check.note: part2 reads only the P1 calibration eval files and its own RNG; the census rows are passed to part2_3 only for the supplementary census-vs-calibration overlap, which does change
